paragraphs: Mia and Leo are at the village funfair. A band plays near the big tree. "Look, Leo! That's my aunt," says Mia. "Which one?" asks Leo. "She's the woman with the red hat. Her name is Anna." "Anna is Grandma's daughter, and I'm her granddaughter." "So Grandma and Grandpa are your grandparents," says Leo. "Yes! They're here with a big blue bag." "I'm very happy to see them," says Mia.

The band is very loud. "What? I can't hear you!" shouts Leo. "It isn't noise, Leo. It's music!" Mia laughs. Aunt Anna plays the guitar and dances. She jumps up and down. Then her red hat flies off her head. "Oh no! It's coming to us!" says Mia. "Don't worry, I'm quick," says Leo. He puts up both hands.

Leo catches the hat! Grandma and Grandpa clap and smile. "Thank you, Leo," says Aunt Anna. "We're a good band, but we aren't good at hats!" "I'm not a good guitar player," says Leo. "But I can catch!" Aunt Anna gives him a sweet. Now the band plays a new song. Mia and Leo sing with them. It's a happy day.
text.summary: Mia and Leo watch Mia's aunt play in a band at the village funfair. Her red hat flies into the air, and Leo catches it.
